notes: 2602.21611 subtask-level memory (seat Δ10): final 61.25. G → son55 2: the gap is concrete, but the neighbours named are instance- or repository-level only; step- or workflow-level memory is not compared, and the 'empirical demonstration' of the mismatch is one case study plus the baseline numbers. X → son55 2: no write gate, no relevance threshold (top-1 is always injected), append-only store, embedding model unnamed, prompts unreleased. E.causality → sol 3: structure-only, category-off and raw-trajectory controls run on the same scaffold and step budget. The category-off arm injects the same top-1 per subtask, so injection quantity is matched. Single-backbone/no-variance limits are E.statistics (A2). E.holdout → son55 2: the prequential stream is label-free and is the paper's stated setting; there is no frozen-store or cross-benchmark test. evidence_level → retained (store-off structure-only arm; precedent r03b Dynamic Cheatsheet, r06b ReasoningBank). Domain → H00 + H03. H03 names 'cutting episodes into functional subtasks' and 'category filter', which is this paper's design; H04 is about hierarchical or graph substrates.

2603.01145 AutoSkill (status conflict): final status reviewed, 27.5. The pinned v2 text is complete. The paper simply contains no downstream evaluation: §5 gives only SkillBank counts, tags and two skill cards. That is rubric A1, not a missing-material case; needs_evidence/needs_fulltext are reserved for material we could not read. All five E items are not_reported = 0 with a search scope. Precedent: r03b 2505.17716 AgentRR (A1, 27.5) and cal-dev 1112.5309. G → sol 2 (the AgentRR precedent). M → son55 2: no outcome signal ever decides whether a skill helps; skills evolve by repetition. X → son55 2: λ/K/η/α and the extraction LLM are unstated, there is no rollback or retirement, and §3.1 says 'five' modules but lists six. claim_support → unsupported; evidence_level → null (no observed gain). sol's seat file was edited in place after the seat run (raw nulled, L/U 40 kept). conflicts.json hashes match the edited version, which is the one aggregated.

2603.02623 Uni-Skill (Δ5): final 56.25. X → son55 2: the base VLM and its 106K-sample training recipe are unnamed, tree-expansion and matching thresholds are absent, and whether L_ext skills persist across tasks is never stated. Shared correction: E.measurement 3 → 2. Table III prints the CaP average as 0.00 while its own per-task values average 0.29, and the introduction's '+34.0% in unseen skills' cannot be recomputed from Table III (+33.3 vs MOKA over the six non-pick-place tasks). Run convention r09b/r10b/r11a caps text–table contradictions at 2. Scope kept in-scope B (both seats): the evaluated, retained object is a non-weight skill repository, while the planner VLM training is a component confound (A3 bullet 2). The only execution-feedback loop is in-episode re-planning. Domain → H07 + H04 (revised; H02's interaction-stream mining does not describe offline video annotation). The Fig. 5 ablation values are image-only, so no number was used.

2603.02766 EvoSkill (equal 58.75, shared-error audit): final 56.25. E.measurement → sol 2. The headline 67.9 (abstract, text, Fig. 2) contradicts Table 1's merge-unique 68.1. BrowseComp 43.5%/48.8% are not integer counts of the stated 128 examples (55.7 and 62.5 correct), so the denominator is unstated. The substring scorer is unaudited. E.causality → sol 2: the base-vs-evolved comparison on the held-out test isolates the retained skill package (skill-only mode inherits the parent's system prompt). Component and prompt-only controls are missing, so it is not 3. E.cost → sol not_reported 0: no iteration count, tokens, dollars or time. 'Computational cost' and '1.5 epochs' are not accounting. Shared correction: E.holdout 3 → 2. The headline is the best of four configurations ranked on the test partition, and merge-unique was added post hoc. Its overlap rule keeps 'the version from the highest-performing run' without naming the split. The test partitions differ across the 5/10/15% configurations, and the baseline's alignment is unstated. The transfer evidence is one skill, one direction, single run. RS → generative_process_redesign/null (ReCreate/SICA convention). Domain → H11 + H15 (revised; H16 rejected because the frontier is a scalar top-k with no complementarity axis).

2603.03329 AutoHarness (Δ5): final 65.0. G → son55 3: illegal moves are a sourced bottleneck (78% of Flash losses), the replaced object (hand-written harness) is explicit, and neighbours (code world models, code-as-policies, Voyager, AlphaEvolve, Tang et al. search) are named with distinctions, but not compared. E.cost → son55 2: learning-step counts are reported per game for all 145 games (the Table 1 caption calls them LLM calls), and test-time cost is compared in policy mode. Retry calls in verifier mode and synthesis tokens/dollars are missing. RS → decompose_and_delegate/C25 (LATM/Alita convention): legality, which the LLM handles unreliably, is offloaded to executable code checked against the environment. son55's recomputation was verified: the 32 starred games average 14.5 learning steps with 19 under 10, while all 145 average 10.3.
